title: The title screen's opening
description: The title screen starts dark, with DEREK YU PRESENTS at the top. A flare falls past the doors and lights the cave as it drops, the Spelunker climbs down the rope beside it and lands, and the player walks left to the nearest of the three doors, SCORES, and goes in.
